sentences.en: Klein also prepares a new prophylactic from the dried organs of a guinea-pig, and one of the most interesting experiments is that of Strong (Archiv far Schiff sand tropische Hygiene, April, 1906), who uses for producing immunity in man a living virulent culture of the bacillus pestis.

sentences.en: This song, written for the movie by Keith Forsey and Steve Schiff, is indisputably the biggest hit from the movie and one of the landmark songs of the decade.

sentences.en: Forsey and Schiff approached Billy Idol and Bryan Ferry to record the song, but both refused.
sentences.vi: Forsey và Schiff tiếp cận Billy Idol và Bryan Ferry để thu âm bài hát, nhưng cả hai đều từ chối.
